name: TC-SR-008 — 产运补拍上传追加新批次 [P1]
description: 验证RETURNED状态下：先看结果视图、点击补充上传创建新批次、提交后追加vN
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const defaultResultView = text.includes('结果视图'); const supplementBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('补充上传')); const reworkReason = text.includes('返修') || text.includes('驳回原因') || text.includes('补拍'); return { defaultResultView, supplementBtn: !!supplementBtn, reworkReason }; })()
steps.description: 验证RETURNED状态默认展示结果视图

steps.expression: (() => { const supplementBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('补充上传')); if (supplementBtn) { supplementBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const uploadPage = text.includes('上传') || text.includes('图组'); const frozenArea = text.includes('v1') || text.includes('历史'); const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('提交补拍')); return { uploadPage, frozenArea, submitBtn: !!submitBtn, submitBtnDisabled: submitBtn?.disabled }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为RETURNED，当前用户是产运
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 验证默认展示结果视图和返修意见
2. 点击补充上传
3. 验证进入上传页
4. 验证历史批次冻结区展示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 默认进入结果视图展示返修意见
2. 点击补充上传后创建新批次编辑区
3. 历史批次作为冻结区只读展示
4. 至少新增1组并满足单组最小集
5. 提交后追加vN批次进入买手审核
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
